definitions.gloss: company director, member of the board of directors
definitions.explanation: A person elected by shareholders to serve on the board of directors of a corporation. Responsible for major business decisions and oversight of company management. A formal legal title under Japanese corporate law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{取締役|とりしまりやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was appointed as a company director.

examples.japanese: ⟦{取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}→取締役会：28600_torishimariyakukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new policy was decided at the board of directors meeting.

examples.japanese: {同社|どうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社外|しゃがい}{取締役|とりしまりやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二名|にめい}⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迎|むか}え→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧、⟦ガバナンス→ガバナンス：07820_gabanansu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: The company will newly appoint two outside directors to strengthen governance.

notes:
USAGE:
{取締役|とりしまりやく} is a formal legal title used in Japanese corporate law ({会社法|かいしゃほう}). The word is commonly abbreviated in compound titles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}→取締役会：28600_torishimariyakukai⟧: board of directors (meeting)
- {代表取締役|だいひょうとりしまりやく}: representative director (CEO equivalent)
- {社外|しゃがい}{取締役|とりしまりやく}: outside director
- ⟦{常務|じょうむ}→常務：27575_joumu⟧{取締役|とりしまりやく}: managing director
- ⟦{専務|せんむ}→専務：19291_senmu⟧{取締役|とりしまりやく}: senior managing director
- {取締役|とりしまりやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be appointed as director
